title: Gemini Neon + Claude Fable Orchestration has been the best AI game development workflow I've tried so far
author: Faisal_alwaal
selftext:
I don't know if this has been discussed here before, but I've recently found that using Gemini Neon for planning and prompting, combined with Claude Fable Orchestration with Opus sub-agents for actual development, has been the best workflow for me so far.

Neon is seriously good at planning and writing prompts. I've been using it to discuss ideas, solve problems, and come up with roadmaps for my game, and it has made developing with Fable so much easier.

One thing I've noticed is how different the experience feels compared to ChatGPT. With ChatGPT, I often felt like I was fighting the system, constantly going back and forth just to get it to understand what I wanted or come up with a decent solution. With Neon, it's honestly been a breath of fresh air. I can just explain what I'm trying to achieve, discuss different approaches, and it actually comes up with some really good solutions and plans.

Then I take those plans and prompts over to Fable, where my Opus sub-agents handle the actual development. So far, this combination has been working incredibly well for me.

If you're currently working on a project, I really recommend giving Neon a shot. Take an issue you've been struggling with, explain it to Neon, have a conversation about possible solutions, work out a plan, and ask it to create a proper prompt for your coding agent.

Just give it a try and see how it goes. I genuinely don't think you'll be disappointed.

Obviously, I'm not saying this is the best workflow for everyone, but for me personally, it's been a huge improvement, and I thought I'd share it here in case someone else finds it useful.

comments.author: pietrzm
comments.body:
How did you integrate both?
Maybe you would like to try https://github.com/novadeck-org/novadeck for this?

It's aim is to make orchestration effortless, so a single prompt "spawn Neon to review your changes" makes it happen.

comments.author: PaintingThat7623
comments.body:
I've just started using Neon today, and boys, I know it's hard to believe, but Opus has been dethroned.

It's cheaper, both token-wise and dollar-wise. It's more intelligent. It's faster. It doesn't write whole essays with unnecesary questions at the end. It has a built in imagegen.

I've been using it for about 8 hours today and holy shit, this is next gen in terms of efficiency. I don't think I can ever run out of limits! Insane!
